channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Negotiations would help Iran’s protesters. War only helps its leaders
item.description: An attack on Iran would bolster its repressive leaders, endanger millions and risk another endless war, this op-ed argues, urging negotiations as the only real help for protesters.

item.title: Build North Carolina’s future with American cement
item.description: As North Carolina tops CNBC’s 2025 rankings, a former GOP leader says the state’s boom should rest on U.S.-made, certified cement, not rising imports, citing jobs, safety and security.

item.title: Transparency will help UNC campuses, not harm them
item.description: UNC's new requirement to post course syllabi publicly will not threaten academic freedom, but instead increase accountability and rebuild public trust in higher education, a conservative columnist argues.

item.title: Ignorant loudmouths
item.description: A Wilson resident compares “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” to today’s immigration and culture wars, urging the silent majority to look beyond loud extremists and engage in open, respectful conversation.

item.title: Black Creek man charged with robbery
item.description: Black Creek man, 20, is accused of robbing buyer of $400 at gunpoint during a planned gun sale, deputies say. He was quickly arrested, the gun was recovered and he remains jailed on $50,000 bond.

item.title: Airport called ‘vital’ to area economy
item.description: Rocky Mount-Wilson Regional Airport, credited with $84M in economic impact and 375 jobs, seeks state and federal funding for new facilities, more hangars and a longer runway.

item.title: City, county had 13 homicides in 2025
item.description: Wilson and Wilson County recorded 13 homicides in 2025, including two double killings, as police and deputies detail each case and stress their push to curb violent crime.

item.title: ‘The system needs an overall overhaul’: Elm City board pursuing sprayfield compliance
item.description: Facing more than $80,000 in state fines over wastewater violations, Elm City leaders are moving to overhaul their sprayfield system and upgrade safety measures.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 15-16, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for Jan. 15-16, 2026, featuring high school boys, girls and JV basketball games across the region and the 5-A/6-A Big East swimming meet at Harrison Family YMCA in Rocky Mount.

item.title: More isn’t always better and sometimes less is more
item.description: Former Duke goalkeeper E.J. Proctor reflects on shifting from always adding more to intentionally shedding commitments to reduce burnout and focus on the activities and roles that matter most.
